"""Exact source-gated Native entrypoint for the six yellow-curb freight cases."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from freight_contract import SourceError, VARIANTS, read_sealed, verify_site
from finalize_original_sources import ASSIGNMENT, finalize
from native_result import write_native_result
from native_session import capture_session


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ORIGINALS = ("native_map", "curb_observation", "sign_observation",
             "commercial_dossier", "civil_time", "comparison_context")


def require(condition: bool, reason: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise SourceError(reason)


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def check(root: Path = ROOT) -> dict:
    config = json.loads((Path(root) / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    require(tuple(config.get(key) for key in ("assignment_id", "law_id", "cell_id", "actor")) ==
            (ASSIGNMENT, "LVMC-11-52-030-B", "C149555", "motor_vehicle_driver"),
            "wrong exact freight assignment")
    case_id = config.get("selected_case_id")
    require(case_id in {ASSIGNMENT + "__" + variant for variant in VARIANTS},
            "unknown exact freight case")
    require(set(config.get("supported_case_ids", [])) ==
            {ASSIGNMENT + "__" + variant for variant in VARIANTS},
            "six-case inventory differs")
    require(tuple(config.get(key) for key in ("rate_hz", "duration_s", "frame_count")) ==
            (20, 45, 900), "original duration or timebase differs")
    from saved_delivery import CAMERAS
    require({item.get("name"): (item.get("width"), item.get("height")) for item in
             config.get("cameras", [])} == CAMERAS, "four original camera profiles differ")
    require(config.get("case", {}).get("case_id") == case_id and
            config["case"].get("variant") == case_id.removeprefix(ASSIGNMENT + "__"),
            "selected freight variant differs")
    return config


def copy_original_sources(source_root: Path, inventory: dict, attempt: Path,
                          *, case_id: str) -> tuple[dict, dict, dict]:
    source_root = Path(source_root).resolve(strict=True)
    require(source_root.is_dir() and attempt.is_dir(), "missing original source or attempt root")
    require(inventory.get("provenance_kind") == "original_native" and
            inventory.get("diagnostic_fixture") is False and
            isinstance(inventory.get("reviewer"), str) and inventory["reviewer"].strip(),
            "reviewed original Native source provenance missing")
    references = inventory.get("sources")
    require(isinstance(references, dict) and set(ORIGINALS) <= set(references),
            "original source inventory incomplete")
    copies = {}
    target_root = attempt / "original-sources"
    target_root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    originals = {}
    for name in ORIGINALS:
        ref = references[name]
        path = (source_root / ref["path"]).resolve(strict=True)
        require(path.is_relative_to(source_root), "original source escapes reviewed root: " + name)
        value = read_sealed(path, ref["sha256"])
        destination = target_root / (name + ".json")
        shutil.copyfile(path, destination)
        require(sha(destination) == ref["sha256"], "original source copy drift: " + name)
        copies[name] = {"path": str(destination.relative_to(attempt)), "sha256": ref["sha256"]}
        originals[name] = value
    site_ref = inventory.get("site")
    require(isinstance(site_ref, dict) and site_ref.get("path") and site_ref.get("sha256"),
            "reviewed original site missing")
    site_path = (source_root / site_ref["path"]).resolve(strict=True)
    require(site_path.is_relative_to(source_root), "reviewed site escapes source root")
    site = read_sealed(site_path, site_ref["sha256"])
    verify_site(site)
    require(site["native_map_sha256"] == copies["native_map"]["sha256"] and
            site["curb_observation_sha256"] == copies["curb_observation"]["sha256"] and
            site["sign_observation_sha256"] == copies["sign_observation"]["sha256"],
            "reviewed site source seals differ")
    require(originals["comparison_context"].get("case_id") == case_id,
            "comparison context case differs")
    require(originals["commercial_dossier"].get("source_sha256") and
            originals["commercial_dossier"].get("enterprise_use_reviewed") is True,
            "enterprise-use dossier not independently sourced and reviewed")
    return site, originals["commercial_dossier"], copies


def run(output: Path, source_root: Path, inventory_path: Path, *, host: str,
        port: int, client_factory=None) -> dict:
    config = check()
    require(os.environ.get("SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT"),
            "runtime output root must be routed to .runtime-work")
    output = Path(output)
    require(output.is_dir() and not any((output / name).exists() for name in
            ("frame-map.jsonl", "freight_motion.jsonl", "result.json",
             "freight-native-source.json", "original-sources")),
            "fresh Native attempt without prior acquisition required")
    inventory_path = Path(inventory_path).resolve(strict=True)
    source_root = Path(source_root).resolve(strict=True)
    require(inventory_path.is_relative_to(source_root), "inventory escapes reviewed source root")
    inventory = read_sealed(inventory_path, sha(inventory_path))
    case_id = config["selected_case_id"]
    site, dossier, copies = copy_original_sources(source_root, inventory, output,
                                                   case_id=case_id)
    if client_factory is None:
        import carla
        client_factory = carla.Client
    client = client_factory(host, port)
    client.set_timeout(30.0)
    capture = capture_session(client, site, dossier, case_id=case_id,
                              variant=config["case"]["variant"], output=output)
    copies["frame_map"] = {"path": "frame-index.json",
                           "sha256": sha(output / "frame-index.json")}
    source_manifest = finalize(output, case_id=case_id, source_refs=copies)
    result_path = write_native_result(output, source_manifest)
    return {"case_id": case_id, "frames": capture["frames"],
            "result_path": str(result_path), "result_sha256": sha(result_path),
            "source_manifest": source_manifest, "media": capture["media"],
            "restoration": capture["restoration"]}


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--source-root", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--source-inventory", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    check()
    if args.check:
        return 0
    source_root = args.source_root or os.environ.get("C149555_SOURCE_ROOT")
    inventory = args.source_inventory or os.environ.get("C149555_SOURCE_INVENTORY")
    require(args.output_dir is not None and source_root is not None and
            inventory is not None, "reviewed original source inventory required")
    print(json.dumps(run(args.output_dir, Path(source_root), Path(inventory),
                         host=args.host, port=args.port), indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Own one freight Native capture session and restore the CARLA world."""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import os
from pathlib import Path

from freight_contract import SourceError, prepare_scene


def capture_session(client, site: dict, dossier: dict, *, case_id: str,
                    variant: str, output: Path, adapter_factory=None,
                    camera_rig_factory=None, pipeline_capture_class=None,
                    frame_capture=None, encoder=None, composer=None,
                    world_restore_module=None, scene_preparer=None) -> dict:
    if not os.environ.get("SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT"):
        raise SourceError("SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT must be set before runtime imports")
    if adapter_factory is None:
        from carla_adapter import NativeCarlaAdapter
        adapter_factory = NativeCarlaAdapter
    if camera_rig_factory is None:
        from camera_rig import CameraRig
        camera_rig_factory = CameraRig
    if pipeline_capture_class is None:
        from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
        pipeline_capture_class = PipelineCapture
    if frame_capture is None:
        from native_capture import capture_original_frames
        frame_capture = capture_original_frames
    if encoder is None:
        from encode_cameras import encode_cameras
        encoder = encode_cameras
    if composer is None:
        from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.media import compose_four_views
        composer = compose_four_views
    if world_restore_module is None:
        from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange import world_restore
        world_restore_module = world_restore
    scene_preparer = scene_preparer or prepare_scene
    output = Path(output)
    if not output.is_dir():
        raise SourceError("materialized Native output directory missing")
    saved = world_restore_module.snapshot(client)
    adapter = None
    failure = None
    result = None
    restoration = None
    try:
        world = client.get_world()
        settings = copy.copy(world.get_settings())
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = 0.05
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        adapter = adapter_factory(world, site, dossier)
        scene_preparer(adapter, site, variant, dossier)
        if adapter.ego is None:
            raise SourceError("freight Native ego was not spawned")
        with camera_rig_factory(adapter, site) as cameras:
            with pipeline_capture_class(client, adapter.ego, output, case_id) as native:
                rows = frame_capture(adapter, adapter.sample_original, output,
                                     case_id=case_id, read_camera=cameras.read_camera,
                                     native_capture=native)
        media = encoder(output)
        composition = composer({name: output / ref["path"] for name, ref in media.items()},
                               output / "frame-map.jsonl", output / "raw.mkv")
        result = {"frames": len(rows), "media": media, "composition": composition}
    except BaseException as error:
        failure = error
        raise
    finally:
        cleanup_error = None
        if adapter is not None:
            try:
                adapter.cleanup()
            except BaseException as error:
                cleanup_error = error
        try:
            restoration = world_restore_module.restore(client, saved)
        except BaseException as error:
            if failure is None and cleanup_error is None:
                raise
            cleanup_error = cleanup_error or error
        if failure is None and cleanup_error is not None:
            raise SourceError("Native cleanup or world restoration failed") from cleanup_error
    return dict(result, restoration=restoration)

"""Original-frame acquisition loop for the signed yellow-curb freight cases.

The caller owns the CARLA world, cameras, encoder and restoration. The sample
callback must read the post-tick live ego/body/cargo state; no commanded target
is used as an observation. Each call is joined to the original Native frame.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path

from freight_contract import SourceError, VARIANTS
from saved_delivery import CAMERAS


ASSIGNMENT = "testing__C149555__LVMC-11-52-030-B__motor_vehicle_driver"


def capture_original_frames(adapter, sample, output_dir: Path, *, case_id: str, frames: int = 900,
                            frame_map_factory=None, read_camera=None,
                            native_capture=None) -> list[dict]:
    if not os.environ.get("SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT"):
        raise SourceError("SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT must route runtime output to .runtime-work")
    if case_id not in {f"{ASSIGNMENT}__{variant}" for variant in VARIANTS}:
        raise SourceError("unknown exact freight case")
    if frames != 900:
        raise SourceError("exact freight delivery requires 900 original frames")
    if (read_camera is None) != (native_capture is None):
        raise SourceError("four cameras and PipelineCapture must be synchronized together")
    if frame_map_factory is None:
        from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap
        frame_map_factory = FrameMap
    output_dir = Path(output_dir)
    if not output_dir.is_dir():
        raise SourceError("original attempt directory missing")
    motion_path = output_dir / "freight_motion.jsonl"
    frame_map_path = output_dir / "frame-map.jsonl"
    frame_index_path = output_dir / "frame-index.json"
    if motion_path.exists() or frame_map_path.exists() or frame_index_path.exists():
        raise SourceError("original acquisition files already exist")
    rows = []
    camera_rows = {name: [] for name in CAMERAS}
    if read_camera is not None:
        for name in CAMERAS:
            (output_dir / "cameras" / name).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    with frame_map_factory(frame_map_path) as frame_map, motion_path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as motion:
        for index in range(frames):
            control = adapter.step_capture(index)
            native_frame = adapter.world.tick()
            snapshot = adapter.world.get_snapshot()
            if snapshot.frame != native_frame:
                raise SourceError("Native snapshot/frame mismatch")
            time_s = snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds
            source = sample(index, native_frame, snapshot)
            if not isinstance(source, dict):
                raise SourceError("missing original motion sample")
            if source.get("original_frame") != index:
                raise SourceError("sample/original frame mismatch")
            if source.get("native_frame") != native_frame:
                raise SourceError("sample/Native frame mismatch")
            if source.get("time_s") != time_s:
                raise SourceError("sample/Native timestamp mismatch")
            if native_capture is not None:
                captured = native_capture.capture(native_frame, time_s)
                if captured.get("frame") != native_frame or captured.get("time_s") != time_s:
                    raise SourceError("PipelineCapture/Native frame join mismatch")
                for name in CAMERAS:
                    image_frame, image_bytes = read_camera(name, native_frame)
                    if image_frame != native_frame or not isinstance(image_bytes, bytes) or \
                            not image_bytes.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"):
                        raise SourceError("original camera frame drift or non-PNG source: " + name)
                    image_path = output_dir / "cameras" / name / f"{index:06d}.png"
                    image_path.write_bytes(image_bytes)
                    camera_rows[name].append({"original_frame": index, "native_frame": native_frame,
                                              "path": str(image_path.relative_to(output_dir)),
                                              "sha256": hashlib.sha256(image_bytes).hexdigest()})
            row = frame_map.append(native_frame, time_s,
                                   controller_phase=control["phase"])
            if row["video_frame"] != index:
                raise SourceError("original video/frame-map identity mismatch")
            motion.write(json.dumps(source, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
            rows.append(source)
    if adapter.phase not in ("hold", "complete"):
        raise SourceError("freight motion did not complete within original capture")
    frame_index_path.write_text(json.dumps({"case_id": case_id,
                                            "frames": [row["original_frame"] for row in rows]},
                                           separators=(",", ":")) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    if read_camera is not None:
        for name, images in camera_rows.items():
            path = output_dir / (name + "-camera.jsonl")
            path.write_text("".join(json.dumps(image, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"
                                    for image in images), encoding="utf-8")
    return rows

"""Write a canonical Native result from sealed freight source measurements."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
from pathlib import Path

from freight_contract import SourceError, VARIANTS, audit_source_bundle, require_case_completion


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def write_native_result(attempt: Path, manifest: dict, *, writer=None) -> Path:
    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve(strict=True)
    case_id = manifest["case_id"]
    variant = case_id.rsplit("__", 1)[-1]
    measured = audit_source_bundle(manifest, case_id=case_id, variant=variant,
                                   source_root=attempt, require_raw=True)
    completion = require_case_completion(measured)
    if writer is None:
        from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.native_output import write_result
        writer = write_result
    videos = [name + ".mkv" for name in
              ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")]
    videos.append("raw.mkv")
    for video in videos:
        if not (attempt / video).is_file():
            raise SourceError("missing retained original video: " + video)
    packet = manifest["sources"]["native_result"]
    source_hashes = {name: ref["sha256"] for name, ref in manifest["sources"].items()}
    source_hashes.update({"raw_" + name: ref["sha256"] for name, ref in
                          manifest["raw_sources"].items()})
    target_checks = []
    targets = {
        "freight_activity": (VARIANTS[variant]["activity"], measured["observed_action"]),
        "commercial_status": (VARIANTS[variant]["commercial"], measured["commercial_status_reviewed"]),
        "stop_inside_yellow_zone": (VARIANTS[variant]["in_zone"], measured["stopped_inside_zone"]),
        "inside_posted_window": (VARIANTS[variant]["in_window"], measured["inside_posted_window"]),
    }
    for target, (requested, value) in targets.items():
        target_checks.append({"target": target, "requested": requested,
                              "measured": value, "method": "sealed original source audit",
                              "tolerance": 0, "matched": value == requested,
                              "physical_cause_confirmed": target in {"freight_activity", "stop_inside_yellow_zone"},
                              "cause_evidence": packet["path"]})
    result = {
        "case_id": case_id,
        "measured_values": measured,
        "target_checks": target_checks,
        "setup_confirmed": True,
        "behavior_attempted": True,
        "maneuver_completed": completion["physical_completion"],
        "termination_reason": "900 original Native frames captured; physical target measured",
        "physical_failure_flags": {"source_integrity": False,
                                   "motion_incomplete": False,
                                   "legal_purpose_unresolved": True},
        "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
        "video_references": videos,
        "video_frame_map_reference": "frame-map.jsonl",
        "recording_description": "Commercial freight vehicle approaches and halts at a sourced yellow curb; cargo motion, posted time and stopped footprint are measured from original frames.",
        "recording_evidence": [{"path": ref["path"], "sha256": ref["sha256"]}
                               for ref in manifest["sources"].values()],
        "realized_observables": {"original_frames": 900,
                                 "final_halt_duration_s": measured["final_halt_duration_s"],
                                 "observed_freight_action": measured["observed_action"],
                                 "source_hashes": source_hashes},
        "physical_checks": {"setup": {"status": "met"},
                            "maneuver": {"status": "met"}},
        "diagnostic_fixture": False,
        "physical_acceptance_claimed": False,
        "legal_conclusion": "unresolved",
    }
    # Native format prohibits a legal verdict, but permits an explicit unresolved
    # note. The independent delivery audit must still review actual pixels.
    return writer(attempt, result)

    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def rows(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    require(path.is_file(), f"missing original acquisition: {path.name}")
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]


def finalize(attempt: Path, *, case_id: str, source_refs: dict) -> dict:
    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve(strict=True)
    source_refs = dict(source_refs)
    require(case_id.startswith(ASSIGNMENT + "__"), "foreign freight case")
    variant = case_id.removeprefix(ASSIGNMENT + "__")
    require(variant in VARIANTS, "unknown exact freight case")
    required = set(SOURCE_FIELDS) - {"native_result", "freight_activity"}
    if "freight_activity" in source_refs:
        required.add("freight_activity")
    require(required | {"comparison_context"} <= set(source_refs), "missing original source reference")
    sources = {}
    for name in required | {"comparison_context"}:
        ref = source_refs[name]
        require(ref.get("path") and ref.get("sha256"), f"missing original source seal: {name}")
        path = (attempt / ref["path"]).resolve(strict=True)
        require(path.is_relative_to(attempt) and path.is_file(),
                f"original source escapes attempt: {name}")
        sources[name] = read_sealed(path, ref["sha256"])

    frame_map = rows(attempt / "frame-map.jsonl")
    motion = rows(attempt / "freight_motion.jsonl")
    require(len(frame_map) == len(motion) == 900, "900 synchronized original samples required")
    require(sources["frame_map"].get("case_id") == case_id and
            sources["frame_map"].get("frames") == list(range(900)),
            "original frame-index source mismatch")
    for index, (frame, sample) in enumerate(zip(frame_map, motion)):
        require(frame.get("video_frame") == sample.get("original_frame") == index,
                "original video/motion frame join mismatch")
        require(frame.get("native_frame") == sample.get("native_frame") and
                frame.get("time_s") == sample.get("time_s"),
                "original Native frame/time join mismatch")

    if "freight_activity" not in sources:
        activity = dict(vehicle_id=sources["commercial_dossier"].get("vehicle_id"),
                        **derive_freight_activity(motion))
        path = attempt / "freight_activity.json"
        with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            json.dump(activity, stream, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
            stream.write("\n")
        source_refs["freight_activity"] = {"path": str(path), "sha256": sha256(path)}
        sources["freight_activity"] = activity

    native_map = sources["native_map"]
    curb = sources["curb_observation"]
    sign = sources["sign_observation"]
    dossier = sources["commercial_dossier"]
    freight = sources["freight_activity"]
    civil_source = sources["civil_time"]
    context = sources["comparison_context"]
    require(context.get("case_id") == case_id, "comparison context case mismatch")
    require(context.get("civil_time_source_sha256") == source_refs["civil_time"]["sha256"],
            "comparison civil-time source mismatch")
    conditions = context.get("posted_conditions", {})
    require(conditions.get("verbatim_text") == sign.get("verbatim_text") and
            conditions.get("civil_windows") == sign.get("civil_windows") and
            conditions.get("freight_permitted") == sign.get("freight_permitted"),
            "comparison sign conditions differ from original source")
    require(context.get("zone") == {"start_station_m": curb.get("start_station_m"),
                                    "end_station_m": curb.get("end_station_m")},
            "comparison zone differs from original curb source")
    civil = dict(civil_source, source_sha256=source_refs["civil_time"]["sha256"])
    packet = {
        "case_id": case_id,
        "variant": variant,
        "map_name": native_map.get("map_name"),
        "native_map_readback": {key: native_map.get(key) for key in
                                ("native_road_id", "native_lane_id", "one_way_native_readback")},
        "one_way_native_readback": native_map.get("one_way_native_readback"),
        "curb_color_observed": curb.get("color"),
        "curb_observation": {key: curb.get(key) for key in
                             ("start_station_m", "end_station_m", "independent_pixel_review")},
        "sign_text_readback": sign.get("verbatim_text"),
        "sign_observation": {"independent_pixel_review": sign.get("independent_pixel_review")},
        "posted_conditions": conditions,
        "zone": context["zone"],
        "vehicle_id": dossier.get("vehicle_id"),
        "commercial_dossier": dossier,
        "freight_activity": freight,
        "civil_time": civil,
        "posted_window_check": {
            "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256((source_refs["sign_observation"]["sha256"] + ":" +
                                             source_refs["civil_time"]["sha256"]).encode()).hexdigest(),
            "derived_from_sign_sha256": source_refs["sign_observation"]["sha256"],
            "inside": inside_posted_window(civil, conditions),
        },
        "comparison_context_sha256": source_refs["comparison_context"]["sha256"],
        "frames": motion,
    }
    for name, field in SOURCE_FIELDS.items():
        if name != "native_result":
            packet[field] = source_refs[name]["sha256"]
    packet_path = attempt / "freight-native-source.json"
    with packet_path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(packet, stream, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")
    refs = dict(source_refs, native_result={"path": str(packet_path), "sha256": sha256(packet_path)})
    manifest = {"case_id": case_id, "kind": "delivery", "acquisition_kind": "original_native",
                "sources": refs,
                "raw_sources": {"frame_map": {"path": str(attempt / "frame-map.jsonl"),
                                              "sha256": sha256(attempt / "frame-map.jsonl")},
                                "motion": {"path": str(attempt / "freight_motion.jsonl"),
                                           "sha256": sha256(attempt / "freight_motion.jsonl")}}}
    audit_source_bundle(manifest, case_id=case_id, variant=variant,
                        source_root=attempt, require_raw=True)
    return manifest


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--case", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-inventory", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    inventory = json.loads(args.source_inventory.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    manifest = finalize(args.attempt, case_id=args.case, source_refs=inventory["sources"])
    output = args.attempt / "freight-source-manifest.json"
    with output.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(manifest, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")
    print(output)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Source-gated yellow-curb freight construction and original-history checks.

This module does not decide whether a particular stop complies with LVMC law.
It requests a scene through an injected Native adapter and checks recorded facts.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path


VARIANTS = {
    "freight_loading": {"activity": "loading", "commercial": True, "in_zone": True, "in_window": True},
    "freight_unloading": {"activity": "unloading", "commercial": True, "in_zone": True, "in_window": True},
    "no_freight_activity": {"activity": "none", "commercial": True, "in_zone": True, "in_window": True},
    "noncommercial_loading": {"activity": "loading", "commercial": False, "in_zone": True, "in_window": True},
    "outside_posted_time": {"activity": "loading", "commercial": True, "in_zone": True, "in_window": False},
    "outside_yellow_zone": {"activity": "loading", "commercial": True, "in_zone": False, "in_window": True},
}


class SourceError(ValueError):
    pass


def _require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise SourceError(message)


def _sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def read_sealed(path: str | Path, expected_sha256: str) -> dict:
    path = Path(path)
    _require(path.is_file(), f"missing original source: {path}")
    _require(_sha(path) == expected_sha256, f"stale original source: {path}")
    result = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    _require(isinstance(result, dict), f"malformed original source: {path}")
    return result


SOURCE_FIELDS = {
    "native_result": "native_result_sha256",
    "frame_map": "frame_map_sha256",
    "native_map": "native_map_sha256",
    "curb_observation": "curb_observation_sha256",
    "sign_observation": "sign_observation_sha256",
    "commercial_dossier": "commercial_dossier_sha256",
    "freight_activity": "freight_activity_source_sha256",
    "civil_time": "civil_time_source_sha256",
}


def audit_source_bundle(manifest: dict, *, case_id: str, variant: str,
                        source_root: Path | None = None,
                        require_raw: bool = False) -> dict:
    """Read sealed original sources, join identities, then measure the packet.

    The manifest is a processor input, never a substitute for original bytes.
    Sources can be held outside the returned work tree during local capture.
    """
    entries = manifest.get("sources", {})
    _require(set(SOURCE_FIELDS) <= set(entries), "incomplete original source inventory")
    sources = {}
    if source_root is not None:
        source_root = source_root.resolve(strict=True)
    for name, field in SOURCE_FIELDS.items():
        ref = entries[name]
        _require(isinstance(ref, dict) and ref.get("path") and ref.get("sha256"), f"missing source reference: {name}")
        path = Path(ref["path"])
        if source_root is not None:
            path = (source_root / path).resolve(strict=True)
            _require(path.is_relative_to(source_root) and path.is_file(),
                     f"original source escapes attempt: {name}")
        sources[name] = read_sealed(path, ref["sha256"])
    packet = dict(sources["native_result"])
    # A source file cannot contain its own cryptographic digest. Bind it after
    # verifying its bytes against the outer manifest.
    packet["native_result_sha256"] = entries["native_result"]["sha256"]
    for name, field in SOURCE_FIELDS.items():
        if name == "native_result":
            continue
        _require(packet.get(field) == entries[name]["sha256"], f"packet/source seal mismatch: {name}")
    _require(sources["frame_map"].get("case_id") == case_id and sources["frame_map"].get("frames") == [f["original_frame"] for f in packet.get("frames", [])], "original frame-map identity mismatch")
    _require(sources["native_map"].get("map_name") == packet.get("map_name"), "Native map name mismatch")
    _require(sources["curb_observation"].get("color") == "yellow", "curb pixels do not support yellow")
    _require(sources["sign_observation"].get("verbatim_text") == packet.get("sign_text_readback"), "sign source/readback mismatch")
    _require(sources["sign_observation"].get("civil_windows") == packet.get("posted_conditions", {}).get("civil_windows"),
             "posted civil windows differ from original sign source")
    _require(sources["sign_observation"].get("freight_permitted") == packet.get("posted_conditions", {}).get("freight_permitted"),
             "freight condition differs from original sign source")
    _require(sources["commercial_dossier"].get("vehicle_id") == packet.get("vehicle_id"), "commercial dossier vehicle mismatch")
    _require(sources["freight_activity"].get("vehicle_id") == packet.get("vehicle_id"), "activity source vehicle mismatch")
    _require(sources["civil_time"].get("timezone") == packet.get("civil_time", {}).get("timezone") and
             sources["civil_time"].get("local_datetime") == packet.get("civil_time", {}).get("local_datetime"),
             "original civil-time source mismatch")
    for name, fields in {
        "native_map": ("native_road_id", "native_lane_id", "one_way_native_readback"),
        "curb_observation": ("start_station_m", "end_station_m", "independent_pixel_review"),
        "sign_observation": ("independent_pixel_review",),
        "commercial_dossier": ("enterprise_use_reviewed", "qualifies_commercial"),
        "freight_activity": ("observed_action", "cargo_actor_id", "observed_transfer_frames"),
    }.items():
        source = sources[name]
        target = packet.get({"native_map": "native_map_readback", "curb_observation": "curb_observation",
                             "sign_observation": "sign_observation", "commercial_dossier": "commercial_dossier",
                             "freight_activity": "freight_activity"}[name], {})
        _require(isinstance(target, dict), f"missing original {name} values")
        for field in fields:
            _require(field in source and field in target and source[field] == target[field],
                     f"original {name} field mismatch: {field}")
    _require(sources["curb_observation"]["independent_pixel_review"] is True,
             "original curb pixel review missing")
    _require(sources["sign_observation"]["independent_pixel_review"] is True,
             "original sign pixel review missing")
    _require(packet.get("civil_time", {}).get("source_sha256") == entries["civil_time"]["sha256"],
             "civil-time source seal mismatch")
    if require_raw:
        _require(source_root is not None, "original attempt root required for raw sources")
        raw = manifest.get("raw_sources", {})
        _require(set(raw) == {"frame_map", "motion"}, "missing raw original acquisition")
        streams = {}
        for name in ("frame_map", "motion"):
            ref = raw[name]
            _require(ref.get("path") and ref.get("sha256"), f"missing raw source seal: {name}")
            path = (source_root / ref["path"]).resolve(strict=True)
            _require(path.is_relative_to(source_root) and path.is_file(),
                     f"raw original source escapes attempt: {name}")
            _require(_sha(path) == ref["sha256"], f"stale raw original source: {name}")
            streams[name] = [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
        _require(len(streams["frame_map"]) == len(streams["motion"]) == 900,
                 "incomplete raw original acquisition")
        _require(streams["motion"] == packet.get("frames"),
                 "raw original motion differs from sealed Native packet")
        for index, (frame, sample) in enumerate(zip(streams["frame_map"], streams["motion"])):
            _require(frame.get("video_frame") == sample.get("original_frame") == index and
                     frame.get("native_frame") == sample.get("native_frame") and
                     frame.get("time_s") == sample.get("time_s"),
                     "raw original frame/time join mismatch")
    return audit_saved_original(packet, case_id=case_id, variant=variant)


def verify_site(site: dict) -> None:
    """Demand sourced physical surface and sign data before constructing a case."""
    _require(site.get("cell_id") == "C149555", "wrong cell")
    _require(site.get("layout") == "one_way_road", "wrong layout")
    _require(site.get("control") == "yellow_curb", "wrong curb control")
    for field in ("native_map_sha256", "native_road_id", "native_lane_id", "curb_observation_sha256", "sign_observation_sha256"):
        _require(bool(site.get(field)), f"missing sourced site field: {field}")
    _require(site.get("curb_color_observed") == "yellow", "yellow curb not observed")
    _require(site.get("sign_text_observed") == site.get("posted_conditions", {}).get("verbatim_text"), "sign text/readback mismatch")
    conditions = site.get("posted_conditions", {})
    _require(isinstance(conditions.get("civil_windows"), list) and conditions["civil_windows"], "missing posted civil windows")
    _require(conditions.get("freight_permitted") is True, "sign does not authorize freight")
    zone = site.get("zone", {})
    _require(zone.get("start_station_m", 0) < zone.get("end_station_m", 0), "invalid zone extent")
    _require(isinstance(site.get("approach_station_m"), (int, float)) and site["approach_station_m"] < zone["start_station_m"], "approach is not before zone")
    _require(isinstance(site.get("outside_station_m"), (int, float)) and site["outside_station_m"] > zone["end_station_m"], "outside-zone point overlaps zone")
    _require(site.get("one_way_native_readback") is True, "one-way Native readback missing")


def prepare_scene(adapter, site: dict, variant: str, commercial_dossier: dict) -> dict:
    """Execute the authored setup through a CARLA-capable adapter, without importing CARLA here.

    The adapter must validate its live map, spawn real world props and actors, and
    report readbacks; requesting these calls is not physical verification.
    """
    verify_site(site)
    _require(variant in VARIANTS, "unknown comparison variant")
    setting = VARIANTS[variant]
    _require(commercial_dossier.get("source_sha256"), "missing commercial-status source")
    _require(commercial_dossier.get("enterprise_use_reviewed") is True, "commercial-status review missing")
    _require(commercial_dossier.get("vehicle_id"), "missing subject vehicle identity")
    _require(commercial_dossier.get("qualifies_commercial") is setting["commercial"], "dossier/variant status mismatch")
    adapter.assert_native_map(site["native_map_sha256"])
    adapter.assert_one_way_lane(site["native_road_id"], site["native_lane_id"])
    adapter.assert_yellow_curb(site["zone"], site["curb_observation_sha256"])
    adapter.set_civil_clock_window(site["posted_conditions"], setting["in_window"])
    sign_id = adapter.spawn_or_verify_sign(site["posted_conditions"], site["sign_observation_sha256"])
    ego_id = adapter.spawn_vehicle(commercial_dossier["vehicle_id"], site["approach_station_m"])
    target = (site["zone"]["start_station_m"] + site["zone"]["end_station_m"]) / 2 if setting["in_zone"] else site["outside_station_m"]
    adapter.drive_to_station(ego_id, target)
    adapter.stop_and_hold(ego_id)
    cargo_id = None
    if setting["activity"] != "none":
        cargo_id = adapter.spawn_freight(site["freight_prop_blueprint"], site["zone"])
        adapter.transfer_freight(ego_id, cargo_id, setting["activity"])
    return {"ego_id": ego_id, "sign_id": sign_id, "cargo_id": cargo_id,
            "target_station_m": target, "variant": variant, "requested_activity": setting["activity"],
            "requested_civil_window": "inside" if setting["in_window"] else "outside"}


def audit_saved_original(packet: dict, *, case_id: str, variant: str) -> dict:
    """Check original-frame evidence and source identities; never use commanded targets."""
    _require(variant in VARIANTS, "unknown comparison variant")
    _require(packet.get("case_id") == case_id, "wrong original case")
    _require(packet.get("variant") == variant, "wrong original variant")
    for field in ("native_result_sha256", "frame_map_sha256", "native_map_sha256", "curb_observation_sha256", "sign_observation_sha256", "commercial_dossier_sha256", "freight_activity_source_sha256", "civil_time_source_sha256"):
        _require(packet.get(field), f"missing original source binding: {field}")
    _require(packet.get("curb_color_observed") == "yellow", "original yellow curb unverified")
    _require(packet.get("one_way_native_readback") is True, "original one-way lane unverified")
    _require(packet.get("sign_text_readback") == packet.get("posted_conditions", {}).get("verbatim_text"), "original sign text mismatch")
    _require(packet.get("vehicle_id") == packet.get("commercial_dossier", {}).get("vehicle_id"), "vehicle/dossier identity mismatch")
    _require(packet.get("commercial_dossier", {}).get("enterprise_use_reviewed") is True, "unreviewed commercial status")
    frames = packet.get("frames", [])
    _require(isinstance(frames, list) and len(frames) == 900, "900 original frames required")
    previous_time = None
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        _require(frame.get("original_frame") == index, "noncontiguous original frame map")
        time_s = frame.get("time_s")
        station = frame.get("ego_station_m")
        speed = frame.get("ego_speed_mps")
        body_min = frame.get("ego_body_station_min_m")
        body_max = frame.get("ego_body_station_max_m")
        _require(all(isinstance(v, (int, float)) and math.isfinite(v) for v in
                     (time_s, station, speed, body_min, body_max)), "invalid original motion/body sample")
        _require(body_min <= station <= body_max, "body footprint excludes ego station")
        _require(speed >= 0 and (previous_time is None or time_s > previous_time), "invalid original time/speed")
        if previous_time is not None:
            _require(abs(time_s - previous_time - 0.05) <= 0.001, "original 20 Hz timeline gap")
        previous_time = time_s
    zone = packet.get("zone", {})
    _require(zone.get("start_station_m", 0) < zone.get("end_station_m", 0), "invalid original zone")
    _require(frames[0]["ego_body_station_max_m"] < zone["start_station_m"],
             "original approach does not begin before zone")
    _require(any(f["ego_speed_mps"] > 0.5 for f in frames),
             "original approach motion missing")
    _require(frames[-1]["ego_station_m"] - frames[0]["ego_station_m"] > 1.0,
             "original approach made no progress")
    _require(all(f["ego_speed_mps"] <= 0.1 for f in frames[-40:]),
             "two-second final hold missing")
    final_hold_start = 899
    while final_hold_start > 0 and frames[final_hold_start - 1]["ego_speed_mps"] <= 0.1:
        final_hold_start -= 1
    stopped = [f for f in frames if f["ego_speed_mps"] <= 0.1]
    _require(stopped, "no original stop samples")
    inside = all(zone["start_station_m"] <= f["ego_body_station_min_m"] and
                 f["ego_body_station_max_m"] <= zone["end_station_m"] for f in stopped)
    outside = all(f["ego_body_station_max_m"] < zone["start_station_m"] or
                  f["ego_body_station_min_m"] > zone["end_station_m"] for f in stopped)
    _require(inside or outside, "stop spans zone boundary")
    activity = packet.get("freight_activity", {})
    _require(activity.get("vehicle_id") == packet["vehicle_id"], "activity/vehicle identity mismatch")
    observed = activity.get("observed_action")
    _require(observed in ("loading", "unloading", "none"), "freight action unobserved")
    derived = derive_freight_activity(frames)
    _require(observed == derived["observed_action"] and
             activity.get("cargo_actor_id") == derived["cargo_actor_id"] and
             activity.get("observed_transfer_frames") == derived["observed_transfer_frames"],
             "freight activity contradicts original cargo trajectory")
    if observed != "none":
        _require(activity.get("cargo_actor_id") and activity.get("observed_transfer_frames"), "freight transfer not evidenced")
        _require(all(isinstance(n, int) and 0 <= n < 900 for n in activity["observed_transfer_frames"]), "bad freight transfer frames")
        _require(all(frames[n]["ego_speed_mps"] <= 0.1 for n in activity["observed_transfer_frames"]),
                 "freight transfer did not occur during original halt")
    else:
        _require(not activity.get("observed_transfer_frames"),
                 "no-activity case contains original transfer frames")
    civil = packet.get("civil_time", {})
    _require(civil.get("source_sha256") and civil.get("timezone") and civil.get("local_datetime"), "civil clock source missing")
    _require(civil["source_sha256"] == packet["civil_time_source_sha256"], "civil-time source seal mismatch")
    window = packet.get("posted_window_check", {})
    _require(window.get("source_sha256") and window.get("derived_from_sign_sha256") == packet["sign_observation_sha256"], "posted window source mismatch")
    _require(isinstance(window.get("inside"), bool), "posted-window status unmeasured")
    _require(window["inside"] is inside_posted_window(civil, packet.get("posted_conditions", {})),
             "posted-window status contradicts sourced civil time and sign")
    return {"case_id": case_id, "variant": variant, "frames_checked": len(frames),
            "vehicle_id": packet["vehicle_id"], "observed_action": observed,
            "final_halt_original_frames": [final_hold_start, 899],
            "final_halt_duration_s": (900 - final_hold_start) / 20,
            "commercial_status_reviewed": packet["commercial_dossier"]["qualifies_commercial"],
            "stopped_inside_zone": inside, "stopped_outside_zone": outside,
            "inside_posted_window": window["inside"],
            "legal_conclusion": "unresolved; independent source review required"}


def derive_freight_activity(frames: list[dict]) -> dict:
    """Measure cargo direction from original pose samples, not case requests."""
    first_actor = frames[0].get("cargo_actor_id")
    if first_actor is None:
        _require(all(frame.get("cargo_actor_id") is None and
                     frame.get("cargo_lateral_offset_m") is None for frame in frames),
                 "untracked original cargo actor")
        return {"observed_action": "none", "cargo_actor_id": None,
                "observed_transfer_frames": []}
    _require(all(frame.get("cargo_actor_id") == first_actor and
                 isinstance(frame.get("cargo_lateral_offset_m"), (int, float)) and
                 math.isfinite(frame["cargo_lateral_offset_m"]) for frame in frames),
             "incomplete original cargo trajectory")
    moved = []
    for index in range(1, len(frames)):
        delta = frames[index]["cargo_lateral_offset_m"] - frames[index - 1]["cargo_lateral_offset_m"]
        if abs(delta) > 0.05:
            moved.append(index)
    displacement = frames[-1]["cargo_lateral_offset_m"] - frames[0]["cargo_lateral_offset_m"]
    _require(len(moved) >= 2 and abs(displacement) > 0.5,
             "original freight transfer motion missing")
    _require(all(frames[index]["ego_speed_mps"] <= 0.1 for index in moved),
             "original cargo moved before halt")
    return {"observed_action": "unloading" if displacement > 0 else "loading",
            "cargo_actor_id": first_actor, "observed_transfer_frames": moved}


def inside_posted_window(civil: dict, conditions: dict) -> bool:
    """Evaluate only the sign's stated civil windows, without a legal cutoff."""
    try:
        instant = datetime.fromisoformat(civil["local_datetime"])
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
        raise SourceError("invalid sourced civil datetime") from error
    windows = conditions.get("civil_windows")
    _require(isinstance(windows, list) and windows, "missing original sign civil windows")

    def minute(value):
        _require(isinstance(value, str) and len(value) == 5 and value[2] == ":", "invalid sign civil window")
        try:
            hour, minute_value = int(value[:2]), int(value[3:])
        except ValueError as error:
            raise SourceError("invalid sign civil window") from error
        _require(0 <= hour < 24 and 0 <= minute_value < 60, "invalid sign civil window")
        return 60 * hour + minute_value

    now = 60 * instant.hour + instant.minute
    for window in windows:
        _require(isinstance(window, dict), "invalid sign civil window")
        days = window.get("weekdays")
        _require(isinstance(days, list) and days and all(type(day) is int and 0 <= day <= 6 for day in days),
                 "invalid sign weekdays")
        start, end = minute(window.get("start")), minute(window.get("end"))
        _require(start != end, "zero-length sign civil window")
        if start < end and instant.weekday() in days and start <= now < end:
            return True
        if start > end and ((instant.weekday() in days and now >= start) or
                            ((instant - timedelta(days=1)).weekday() in days and now < end)):
            return True
    return False


def audit_comparison(left: dict, right: dict, changed_field: str) -> dict:
    """Reject uncontrolled scene differences in two source-bound saved packets."""
    _require(changed_field in {"freight_action", "commercial_status", "posted_window", "stop_zone"}, "unknown comparison variable")
    for field in ("native_map_sha256", "curb_observation_sha256", "sign_observation_sha256", "zone", "posted_conditions"):
        _require(left.get(field) == right.get(field), f"uncontrolled fixed condition: {field}")
    fixed = {"freight_action": ("commercial_dossier", "posted_window_check", "frames"),
             "commercial_status": ("freight_activity", "posted_window_check", "frames"),
             "posted_window": ("commercial_dossier", "freight_activity", "frames"),
             "stop_zone": ("commercial_dossier", "freight_activity", "posted_window_check")}[changed_field]
    for field in fixed:
        if field == "frames":
            # Motion is measured, so compare the stopped footprint rather than
            # command or exact simulator frame bytes.
            continue
        _require(left.get(field) == right.get(field), f"uncontrolled fixed condition: {field}")
    return {"left_case_id": left.get("case_id"), "right_case_id": right.get("case_id"),
            "deliberate_difference": changed_field, "fixed_conditions_checked": list(fixed) + ["native_map_sha256", "curb_observation_sha256", "sign_observation_sha256", "zone", "posted_conditions"]}


def require_case_completion(measured: dict) -> dict:
    """Check physical case target from saved measurements, separately from law."""
    variant = measured.get("variant")
    _require(variant in VARIANTS, "unknown case variant")
    target = VARIANTS[variant]
    _require(measured.get("frames_checked") == 900, "incomplete recorded duration")
    _require(measured.get("observed_action") == target["activity"], "freight action did not match case target")
    _require(measured.get("commercial_status_reviewed") is target["commercial"], "commercial status did not match case target")
    _require(measured.get("stopped_inside_zone") is target["in_zone"], "stopped footprint did not match case target")
    _require(measured.get("inside_posted_window") is target["in_window"], "posted-time relation did not match case target")
    return {"case_id": measured["case_id"], "physical_completion": True, "legal_conclusion": "unresolved"}

"""Recorded-only lossless encoding of four original 20 Hz camera sources."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from freight_contract import SourceError
from saved_delivery import CAMERAS, probe_and_decode


def require(condition: bool, reason: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise SourceError(reason)


def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def encode_cameras(attempt: Path, *, run_encoder=None, media_probe=None) -> dict:
    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve(strict=True)
    run_encoder = run_encoder or subprocess.run
    media_probe = media_probe or probe_and_decode
    frame_map = [json.loads(line) for line in
                 (attempt / "frame-map.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
    require(len(frame_map) == 900, "900 original camera frames required")
    for index, row in enumerate(frame_map):
        require(row.get("video_frame") == index and isinstance(row.get("native_frame"), int),
                "invalid original camera frame map")
    media = {}
    for name, size in CAMERAS.items():
        index_path = attempt / (name + "-camera.jsonl")
        require(index_path.is_file(), f"missing original camera index: {name}")
        rows = [json.loads(line) for line in index_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
        require(len(rows) == 900, f"incomplete original camera: {name}")
        for index, row in enumerate(rows):
            expected = f"cameras/{name}/{index:06d}.png"
            require(row.get("original_frame") == index and
                    row.get("native_frame") == frame_map[index]["native_frame"] and
                    row.get("path") == expected,
                    f"original camera frame join mismatch: {name}")
            path = (attempt / expected).resolve(strict=True)
            require(path.is_relative_to(attempt) and path.is_file(),
                    f"original camera pixels escape attempt: {name}")
            pixels = path.read_bytes()
            require(hashlib.sha256(pixels).hexdigest() == row.get("sha256") and
                    pixels.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"),
                    f"stale original camera pixels: {name}")
        output = attempt / (name + ".mkv")
        require(not output.exists(), f"retained original camera video exists: {name}")
        command = ["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-framerate", "20",
                   "-i", str(attempt / "cameras" / name / "%06d.png"),
                   "-c:v", "ffv1", "-level", "3", "-n", str(output)]
        result = run_encoder(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
        require(result.returncode == 0 and output.is_file(), f"lossless camera encode failed: {name}")
        info = media_probe(output)
        require((info.get("width"), info.get("height")) == size and
                info.get("r_frame_rate") == "20/1" and
                str(info.get("nb_read_frames")) == "900",
                f"original encoded camera profile mismatch: {name}")
        media[name] = {"path": output.name, "sha256": sha256(output)}
    return media

"""Independent post-capture freight source and four-view media audit.

The default media probe performs a full FFmpeg decode. Diagnostic fixtures can
exercise the algorithm, but they cannot establish original physical visibility.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from freight_contract import SourceError, VARIANTS, audit_source_bundle, require_case_completion


ASSIGNMENT = "testing__C149555__LVMC-11-52-030-B__motor_vehicle_driver"
CAMERAS = {
    "overview": (1920, 1080),
    "approach": (1280, 720),
    "reference_corner": (1280, 720),
    "driver_reference": (1280, 720),
}


def require(condition: bool, reason: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise SourceError(reason)


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def probe_and_decode(path: Path) -> dict:
    probe = subprocess.run(
        ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-count_frames", "-select_streams", "v:0",
         "-show_entries", "stream=width,height,r_frame_rate,nb_read_frames", "-of", "json", str(path)],
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
    )
    streams = json.loads(probe.stdout).get("streams", [])
    require(len(streams) == 1, "media must have one primary video stream")
    decode = subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-i", str(path),
                             "-map", "0:v:0", "-f", "null", "-"],
                            capture_output=True, text=True)
    require(decode.returncode == 0, "full video decode failed")
    return streams[0]


def audit_delivery(manifest: dict, *, attempt_root: Path, media_probe=probe_and_decode) -> dict:
    case_id = manifest.get("case_id")
    require(isinstance(case_id, str) and case_id.startswith(ASSIGNMENT + "__"), "foreign delivery case")
    variant = case_id.removeprefix(ASSIGNMENT + "__")
    require(variant in VARIANTS, "unknown freight variant")
    require(manifest.get("kind") == "delivery", "source is not a delivery attempt")
    require(manifest.get("acquisition_kind") == "original_native", "diagnostic source cannot satisfy delivery audit")
    for field in ("job_id", "attempt_id", "recording_id", "native_result_sha256"):
        require(manifest.get(field), f"missing delivery identity: {field}")
    native = manifest.get("sources", {}).get("native_result", {})
    require(native.get("sha256") == manifest["native_result_sha256"], "Native result seal mismatch")
    attempt_root = attempt_root.resolve(strict=True)
    measured = audit_source_bundle(manifest, case_id=case_id, variant=variant,
                                   source_root=attempt_root, require_raw=True)
    completion = require_case_completion(measured)
    media = manifest.get("media")
    require(isinstance(media, dict) and set(media) == set(CAMERAS), "four original camera sources required")
    media_digests = {}
    for name, size in CAMERAS.items():
        ref = media[name]
        require(isinstance(ref, dict) and ref.get("path") and ref.get("sha256"), f"missing media source: {name}")
        path = (attempt_root / ref["path"]).resolve(strict=True)
        require(path.is_relative_to(attempt_root) and path.is_file(), f"media escapes attempt: {name}")
        require(sha256_file(path) == ref["sha256"], f"stale media source: {name}")
        info = media_probe(path)
        require((info.get("width"), info.get("height")) == size, f"wrong camera size: {name}")
        require(info.get("r_frame_rate") == "20/1", f"wrong camera rate: {name}")
        require(str(info.get("nb_read_frames")) == "900", f"wrong camera frame count: {name}")
        media_digests[name] = ref["sha256"]
    return {
        "format": "worker-freight-saved-delivery-audit",
        "case_id": case_id,
        "job_id": manifest["job_id"],
        "attempt_id": manifest["attempt_id"],
        "recording_id": manifest["recording_id"],
        "native_result_sha256": manifest["native_result_sha256"],
        "frames_checked": measured["frames_checked"],
        "media_sha256": media_digests,
        "source_integrity": True,
        "full_video_decode": True,
        "physical_case_completion": completion["physical_completion"],
        "actual_pixels_reviewed": False,
        "legal_conclusion": "unresolved",
    }


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--manifest", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    manifest = json.loads(args.manifest.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    print(json.dumps(audit_delivery(manifest, attempt_root=args.attempt), indent=2, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Independent exact-pair freight comparison over sealed saved sources.

This checks observation and comparison isolation. It makes no legal finding and
does not turn a diagnostic fixture into an original recording.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

from freight_contract import SourceError, audit_source_bundle, read_sealed, require_case_completion
from saved_delivery import audit_delivery, probe_and_decode


ASSIGNMENT = "testing__C149555__LVMC-11-52-030-B__motor_vehicle_driver"
PAIRS = {
    "activity_direction": ("freight_loading", "freight_unloading", "observed_action"),
    "activity_presence": ("freight_loading", "no_freight_activity", "observed_action"),
    "commercial_status": ("freight_loading", "noncommercial_loading", "commercial_status_reviewed"),
    "posted_time": ("freight_loading", "outside_posted_time", "inside_posted_window"),
    "zone_footprint": ("freight_loading", "outside_yellow_zone", "stopped_inside_zone"),
}


def require(condition: bool, reason: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise SourceError(reason)


def audit_pair(left_manifest: dict, right_manifest: dict, comparison_id: str,
               *, attempt_roots: tuple[Path, Path] | None = None,
               media_probe=None) -> dict:
    require(comparison_id in PAIRS, "unknown freight comparison")
    left_variant, right_variant, changed_measurement = PAIRS[comparison_id]
    packets = []
    measured = []
    delivery_audits = []
    for side, (manifest, variant) in enumerate(((left_manifest, left_variant), (right_manifest, right_variant))):
        case_id = f"{ASSIGNMENT}__{variant}"
        require(manifest.get("case_id") == case_id, "comparison exact case mismatch")
        require(manifest.get("kind") == "delivery", "comparison requires delivery source")
        require(manifest.get("acquisition_kind") == "original_native", "diagnostic source cannot satisfy delivery comparison")
        root = attempt_roots[side].resolve(strict=True) if attempt_roots else None
        if root is not None:
            delivery_audits.append(audit_delivery(
                manifest, attempt_root=root, media_probe=media_probe or probe_and_decode))
        result = audit_source_bundle(manifest, case_id=case_id, variant=variant,
                                     source_root=root, require_raw=root is not None)
        require_case_completion(result)
        context_ref = manifest.get("sources", {}).get("comparison_context", {})
        require(context_ref.get("path") and context_ref.get("sha256"), "missing sealed comparison context")
        context_path = Path(context_ref["path"])
        native_ref = manifest["sources"]["native_result"]
        native_path = Path(native_ref["path"])
        if root is not None:
            context_path = (root / context_path).resolve(strict=True)
            native_path = (root / native_path).resolve(strict=True)
            require(context_path.is_relative_to(root) and native_path.is_relative_to(root),
                    "comparison source escapes original attempt")
        packet = read_sealed(context_path, context_ref["sha256"])
        native = read_sealed(native_path, native_ref["sha256"])
        require(native.get("comparison_context_sha256") == context_ref["sha256"], "comparison context seal mismatch")
        require(packet.get("case_id") == case_id, "comparison context case mismatch")
        require(packet.get("civil_time_source_sha256") == manifest["sources"]["civil_time"]["sha256"],
                "comparison civil-time source mismatch")
        packets.append(packet)
        measured.append(result)

    left, right = packets
    fixed = (
        "native_map_sha256", "native_road_id", "native_lane_id", "curb_observation_sha256",
        "sign_observation_sha256", "zone", "posted_conditions", "camera_plan_sha256",
        "capture_rate_hz", "capture_frames", "ego_controller_sha256", "freight_prop_blueprint",
    )
    for key in fixed:
        require(left.get(key) is not None and left[key] == right.get(key), f"uncontrolled fixed condition: {key}")
    require(left["capture_rate_hz"] == 20 and left["capture_frames"] == 900, "comparison capture contract mismatch")

    # Cases may have different original recording files and actor IDs. Compare
    # source-bound observed dimensions, rather than identical trace bytes.
    dimensions = ("observed_action", "commercial_status_reviewed", "inside_posted_window", "stopped_inside_zone")
    for key in dimensions:
        equal = measured[0][key] == measured[1][key]
        require(not equal if key == changed_measurement else equal,
                f"comparison did not isolate {key}")
    require(measured[0]["stopped_outside_zone"] == (not measured[0]["stopped_inside_zone"]), "left zone classification incomplete")
    require(measured[1]["stopped_outside_zone"] == (not measured[1]["stopped_inside_zone"]), "right zone classification incomplete")

    # The commercial-status comparison necessarily changes the subject vehicle.
    # In other comparisons, a changed vehicle/dossier could confound the result.
    if comparison_id == "commercial_status":
        require(left.get("vehicle_id") != right.get("vehicle_id"), "commercial-status cases require distinct reviewed vehicles")
    else:
        require(left.get("vehicle_id") == right.get("vehicle_id"), "uncontrolled vehicle identity change")
        require(left.get("commercial_dossier_sha256") == right.get("commercial_dossier_sha256"), "uncontrolled commercial dossier change")
    if comparison_id != "posted_time":
        require(left.get("civil_time_source_sha256") == right.get("civil_time_source_sha256"), "uncontrolled civil-time source change")

    return {
        "format": "worker-freight-comparison-audit",
        "comparison_id": comparison_id,
        "case_ids": [left_manifest["case_id"], right_manifest["case_id"]],
        "source_integrity": True,
        "physical_case_completion": True,
        "actual_pixels_reviewed": False,
        "delivery_audits": [{"native_result_sha256": audit["native_result_sha256"],
                             "media_sha256": audit["media_sha256"],
                             "frames_checked": audit["frames_checked"]}
                            for audit in delivery_audits],
        "fixed_conditions_checked": list(fixed),
        "deliberate_measurement": changed_measurement,
        "legal_conclusion": "unresolved",
    }


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--comparison", required=True, choices=PAIRS)
    parser.add_argument("--left", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--right", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--left-attempt", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--right-attempt", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    left = json.loads(args.left.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    right = json.loads(args.right.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    print(json.dumps(audit_pair(left, right, args.comparison,
                                attempt_roots=(args.left_attempt, args.right_attempt)),
                     indent=2, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Verify an independent review against original and encoded camera pixels.

The review is an external observation. This module never creates one or infers
visibility from a case label. Each cited frame must still match both original
PNG bytes and the corresponding saved lossless video frame.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

from freight_contract import SourceError
from saved_delivery import CAMERAS


PHASES = {"approach": range(0, 300), "halt": range(300, 700),
          "freight": range(700, 900)}
ROLES = {
    "overview": ("yellow_curb_visible", "ego_visible", "sign_visible"),
    "approach": ("yellow_curb_visible", "ego_visible"),
    "reference_corner": ("yellow_curb_visible", "ego_visible", "cargo_visible"),
    "driver_reference": ("ego_visible", "sign_visible"),
}


def require(condition: bool, reason: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise SourceError(reason)


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def decode_frame(video: Path, index: int) -> bytes:
    command = ["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-i", str(video),
               "-vf", f"select=eq(n\\,{index})", "-frames:v", "1",
               "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "rgb24", "-"]
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True)
    require(result.returncode == 0, "reviewed video frame failed to decode")
    return result.stdout


def audit_pixels(manifest: dict, *, attempt: Path, review: dict,
                 decode=decode_frame) -> dict:
    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve(strict=True)
    require(review.get("format") == "worker-freight-pixel-review-v1",
            "independent pixel review format missing")
    require(review.get("case_id") == manifest.get("case_id") and
            review.get("native_result_sha256") == manifest.get("native_result_sha256"),
            "independent pixel review source identity differs")
    require(isinstance(review.get("reviewer"), str) and review["reviewer"].strip() and
            isinstance(review.get("method"), str) and review["method"].strip(),
            "independent pixel review attribution missing")
    views = review.get("views")
    require(isinstance(views, dict) and set(views) == set(CAMERAS),
            "independent pixel review omits a camera")
    receipt = {}
    for name, size in CAMERAS.items():
        video_ref = manifest["media"][name]
        video = (attempt / video_ref["path"]).resolve(strict=True)
        require(video.is_relative_to(attempt) and sha(video) == video_ref["sha256"],
                "reviewed video changed: " + name)
        entries = views[name]
        require(isinstance(entries, list) and len(entries) >= 3,
                "review needs approach, halt and freight frames: " + name)
        seen = set()
        phase_seen = set()
        for entry in entries:
            frame = entry.get("frame")
            require(type(frame) is int and 0 <= frame < 900 and frame not in seen,
                    "invalid reviewed frame: " + name)
            seen.add(frame)
            phase_seen.update(phase for phase, span in PHASES.items() if frame in span)
            require(all(entry.get(role) is True for role in ROLES[name]),
                    "required physical feature not visible: " + name)
            source = (attempt / "cameras" / name / f"{frame:06d}.png").resolve(strict=True)
            require(source.is_relative_to(attempt) and source.is_file() and
                    sha(source) == entry.get("original_png_sha256"),
                    "reviewed original pixel source differs: " + name)
            with Image.open(BytesIO(source.read_bytes())) as image:
                require(image.size == size, "reviewed original pixel size differs: " + name)
                original_rgb = image.convert("RGB").tobytes()
            require(decode(video, frame) == original_rgb,
                    "encoded video pixels differ from reviewed original: " + name)
        require(phase_seen == set(PHASES), "review does not span physical phases: " + name)
        receipt[name] = sorted(seen)
    return {"format": "worker-freight-pixel-audit-v1",
            "case_id": manifest["case_id"], "actual_pixels_reviewed": True,
            "reviewed_frames": receipt, "legal_conclusion": "unresolved"}


def main() -> None:
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--manifest", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--review", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    manifest = json.loads(args.manifest.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    review = json.loads(args.review.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    print(json.dumps(audit_pixels(manifest, attempt=args.attempt, review=review),
                     sort_keys=True, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Independent production audit of a saved freight delivery attempt.

The processing receipt and human pixel review must both refer to preserved
original sources. A clean receipt cannot substitute for physical observation.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from freight_contract import SourceError
from pixel_review import audit_pixels
from saved_delivery import audit_delivery


def require(condition: bool, reason: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise SourceError(reason)


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def read(path: Path) -> dict:
    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    require(isinstance(value, dict), "delivery artifact is not a JSON object")
    return value


def audit(attempt: Path, processing_path: Path, review_path: Path, *,
          media_probe=None, pixel_decode=None) -> dict:
    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve(strict=True)
    processing_path = Path(processing_path).resolve(strict=True)
    review_path = Path(review_path).resolve(strict=True)
    manifest_path = attempt / "freight-delivery-manifest.json"
    manifest = read(manifest_path)
    processing = read(processing_path)
    case_id = manifest.get("case_id")
    require(processing.get("format") == "worker-saved-processing" and
            processing.get("case_id") == case_id and
            processing.get("passed") is True and
            processing.get("originals_preserved") is True,
            "successful saved-only processing receipt missing")
    preserved = processing.get("original_source_hashes")
    require(isinstance(preserved, dict), "saved original source inventory missing")
    required = {manifest_path.name}
    for section in ("sources", "raw_sources", "media"):
        for ref in manifest.get(section, {}).values():
            path = (attempt / ref["path"]).resolve(strict=True)
            require(path.is_relative_to(attempt), "delivery source escapes original attempt")
            required.add(str(path.relative_to(attempt)))
    require(required <= set(preserved), "processing receipt omitted original sources")
    for relative, digest in preserved.items():
        source = (attempt / relative).resolve(strict=True)
        require(source.is_relative_to(attempt) and source.is_file() and sha(source) == digest,
                "saved original changed: " + relative)
    result_path = Path(processing.get("result", ""))
    require(result_path.is_file() and sha(result_path) == processing.get("result_sha256"),
            "saved processing result changed")
    result = read(result_path)
    require(result.get("case_id") == case_id and
            result.get("diagnostic_fixture") is False,
            "saved result identity or provenance differs")
    delivery = audit_delivery(manifest, attempt_root=attempt,
                              **({"media_probe": media_probe} if media_probe else {}))
    require(delivery["physical_case_completion"] is True and
            delivery["full_video_decode"] is True,

import argparse

def finalize(attempt: Path, output: Path) -> dict:
    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve(strict=True)
    manifest = json.loads((attempt / "freight-delivery-manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    measured = audit_delivery(manifest, attempt_root=attempt)
    report = {
        "format": "worker-freight-saved-analysis-v1",
        "case_id": measured["case_id"],
        "diagnostic_fixture": False,
        "physical_completion": measured["physical_case_completion"],
        "source_integrity": measured["source_integrity"],
        "full_video_decode": measured["full_video_decode"],
        "actual_pixels_reviewed": False,
        "legal_judgment": "unresolved_review",
        "measurements": {
            "freight_original_frames": {
                "value": measured["frames_checked"], "unit": "frames",

                "reference": "freight_motion.jsonl",
            },

                "value": measured["physical_case_completion"], "unit": "boolean",
                "method": "source-bound exact freight case completion check",
                "reference": "freight-native-source.json",
            },
        },
    }

    if output.exists():
        raise ValueError("retain prior saved analysis; choose fresh output")
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()

if __name__ == "__main__":
